findings.claim: the new wiring self-test cases read the plugin manifest unconditionally — a vendored tree without the plugin crashes the battery on ENOENT instead of judging
findings.proof: vendor task-coverage.mjs alone into a scratch tree and run --self-test: readFileSync throws, exit nonzero, the whole battery fails for a missing optional component

findings.claim: the review's batteryGreen-defaults-true judgement call: evaluateTransition's facts.batteryGreen defaults true, so a caller who forgets to run the battery gets green
findings.justification: the default is load-bearing for the advisory paths: obligations() and status deliberately call the pure judge WITHOUT fs facts — a default-false batteryGreen would make every status read report a battery obligation status never ran; the enforced path (cmdAdvance) always supplies the real fact, and the guard note documents the seam

findings.claim: the doctor's new wiring check fails in any tree that vendors the harness without the plugin — a port-time decision the check currently makes unilaterally
findings.justification: the check's null-branch message already names the tension (plugin gone while its law is a battery member); whether a vendored tree ships the plugin is the port's decision to make loudly, and the self-test now tolerates absence with a visible skip while the doctor refuses it — the port confronts the choice instead of silently passing
